note: Extra held-out test: documents generated after typelogic-distill-v1 was frozen; none of them is in v1.
decontamination: Documents sharing more than two 8-word sequences with the public JevBench items are dropped.
consensus: Author answer + teacher votes; kept when the soft consensus equals the author answer and at least 3 voters agree.
overlap_rule: Documents sharing more than two 8-word sequences with any typelogic-distill-v1 document (any split) are dropped, the same rule as the JevBench decontamination.
